findings.message: AC-10 says a module's migrations touch only their own schema, but this fix only drops the constraint afterwards. Migration 0009_entry_proposal.sql:3 still says `references delivery.proposal(id)`, so every fresh install still creates a foreign key into Delivery's schema. That step only works if Delivery's tables already exist when Time migrates. The test only checks the end state after 0010. Note in the change that 0009 still references `delivery.proposal`, and say why it stays: an applied migration can't be edited. Or explain how the runner orders the two modules.
findings.scenario: A fresh database where Time's migrations run before Delivery's, or with Delivery switched off: 0009 fails with `relation delivery.proposal does not exist` before 0010 can drop the key.

findings.message: `ProposalTimeSource` is a published contract that Time already fills. Its return type changed from `ProposalTimeLine[]` to `{ lines, partial }`. The module standard says changing a contract after another module uses it needs a new version and a note in the module README. modules/delivery/README.md has no note for this change. Add one, and version the slot type.
findings.scenario: A Time build still on the old shape fills `delivery.proposal-time`. `read.flatMap((r) => r.lines)` gets undefined lines and the page fails, and nothing in the README warned about the change.

findings.message: The AC6 test's `finally` hard-codes `setInstalledModules(["delivery", "time"])` instead of putting back the earlier value, which is usually unset (null). For the rest of the worker, `hasModule(id, true)` then answers false for every other module, such as allocations or presales. Later tests then pass or fail depending on the order they run in. Save the old value and restore it, or add a test-only reset to `installed.ts`.
findings.scenario: A later test in the same worker expects an optional integration with another module to be on. After AC6 runs, `hasModule('allocations', true)` returns false and that test fails only when run after this file.
